_comment: Installed size of desktop/requirements.txt, in MiB. Enforced by .github/workflows/desktop-size.yml, which fails when a change grows this by more than tolerance_percent. Regenerate deliberately (see the workflow's failure message) when an increase is intended — do not bump it to make a red build green without knowing why it grew.
context: Server dependency set is ~1100 MiB; the desktop set excludes torch, sentence-transformers and their transitive deps (scipy, sympy, sklearn, transformers).
